title: New SSVEP frequencies
question: What lets a decoder answer an SSVEP frequency it never trained on?
metric_units: Accuracies, balanced accuracies, transition shares, chance levels and the bet threshold are proportions in [0,1]. An entry with unit "difference of proportions" is a paired difference, stored as a proportion: multiply by 100 for percentage points. The protected margin is in units of CCA correlation. Counts of people, windows, folds, rotations, seeds, fits, parameters and prediction instances are whole numbers. "no training" or "deterministic fit" stands where a trained level gives its seed count; null means not defined or not computed, never zero.
scope: Seven audited follow-ups to route 3 on SSVEP frequencies a decoder never trained on. Six use the BETA cohort route 3 studied (cards 1 to 6); the seventh runs the card 6 models unchanged on Wearable-102 (card 7). Each study block is read from its own audited export and carries its own interval method. Seen and held-out results are separate tasks, reported side by side. Every figure compares set-ups on fixed splits.

descriptive_readoffs.nn8: For each held frequency f, average this arm's scores for adjacent seen-frequency queries f-0.2 Hz and f+0.2 Hz (use the one valid neighbour at a grid edge); then choose among the eight held-frequency alternatives. This is a neighbour interpolation read-off, not direct held-query accuracy u8.
descriptive_readoffs.u3: For trials with true held frequency f, compare query scores for f and its in-grid adjacent seen frequencies f-0.2 Hz and f+0.2 Hz. Candidate selection uses the true target to define this local diagnostic; edge cases have two candidates. It is not a standalone deployment decoder or the eight-way u8 task. At L1 this diagnostic also involves associated stimulus phase: embeddings may retain phase, so it does not isolate frequency alone.
descriptive_readoffs.ties: Candidate frequencies are in ascending order; exact score ties select the lowest frequency.

caveats: Augmentation is a common spectral delay of already windowed coefficients, not literal raw recropping.
One-period delay support depends on the assigned training label.
Nominal evaluation inputs and all reference queries remain unchanged.
Target-linked JFPM phase is valid label-correlated information.
Do not claim chance equivalence, phase irrelevance, a unique memorization diagnosis or a universal architectural limitation.
Historical magnitude comparison differs in feature/query recipe and capacity.
Prior BETA outcomes are exposed; this is not a new external validation.

not_published: Per-person, per-fold, per-rotation, per-seed, per-window and per-frequency values of any kind, predictions, scores, features, fitted heads and the sealed run files: only cohort levels, paired contrasts with their intervals, transition shares and check counts are published.

The handoffs, protocols, freezes, receipts, reviews and the canonical jitter score themselves: each is pinned by SHA-256 in the release manifest and checked by the export; several carry private storage paths.
The cross-spectral round: in progress at the freeze; its status card carries no figures, and it ships as its own file and release.
